title: Sufficient Vision Transformer

problem.claim: Task-irrelevant information, including background nuisance and noise in patch tokens, can damage the performance of Vision Transformer-based models.

gap.claim: The abstract presents the need for a solution that accurately disentangles and discards task-irrelevant information from patch tokens.

contributions.claim: Suf-ViT applies Sufficiency-Blocks across model depth to disentangle and discard task-irrelevant information.
Suf-ViT uses a Sufficient-Reduction Loss based on Mutual Information to remove task-irrelevant information and extract sufficient representations.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report state-of-the-art or competing performance against baseline methods on ImageNet, ImageNet-C, and CIFAR-10.
The authors report that code is available in a public repository.

narrative_sequence.summary: Vision Transformer and its variants have shown promising performance across computer vision tasks.
Background nuisance and noise in patch tokens can harm ViT-based model performance.
The paper introduces Suf-ViT with Sufficiency-Blocks for disentangling and discarding task-irrelevant information.
Sufficient-Reduction Loss uses Mutual Information to support extraction of more reliable sufficient representations.
Experiments on ImageNet, ImageNet-C, and CIFAR-10 are reported to show state-of-the-art or competing performance.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the model architecture details or training procedure.
The abstract does not provide quantitative results, baseline identities, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not independently verify the reported performance claims.
